terra.problem: The moment “Spies speak of Micah’s idols” takes place at Micah’s house in the hill country of Ephraim, not at Laish (Judges 18:13–15).
The first moment says Laish had “no strong ruler,” but Judges 18:7 says there was “no oppressive ruler.” A ruler can be strong without being oppressive.
Terms such as “ephod,” “graven image,” and “forefather” may be difficult at a fifth-grade reading level. Brief explanations or simpler wording would help.
